problems.problem: The promised 'second sparser set of contour rings continuing faintly behind the middle zone' did not render in image 1: below the wavy contour-field edge (approx y 480-560) there is only one hard tonal step (approx y 600-660, visible left and right of the slab) and then a completely unmodulated teal field for the remaining ~60% of the canvas, including the whole type plaque. The line-density descent narrative therefore collapses into a single decorative header patch over an empty wall, while references 3-4 keep graded atmosphere or compositional graphics working behind the subject all the way down the frame.

The plaque stack is bottom-heavy and its steps are uneven: measured gaps are base 1030 to logo top 1080 = 50px, logo bottom 1104 to title top 1152 = 48px, title bottom 1241 to subtitle top 1270 = 29px, subtitle bottom 1288 to rule 1332 = 44px, so the title-to-subtitle step is half every other step and the lockup reads cramped at its centre; the closing rule (130px wide, y 1332) is also a faint hairline tick rather than a confident survey tick, leaving the footer under-weighted against the 721px title.

The 721px-wide title (bbox x 228-949) now anchors the plaque, but the bottle silhouette above it (328px wide) leaves the middle zone between shoulder and plaque carried only by flat teal; the eye drops from the dense contour header straight to the type with no intermediate graphic event, so the vertical hierarchy reads header-subject-gap-footer instead of one continuous descent.

changes.value: Seamless flat matte card in deep petrol teal, thin pale ice-blue bathymetric contour lines engraved densely across the upper third like a sea-floor survey map, the engraved lines continuing as a second much sparser fainter set of contour rings through the middle zone on both sides of the centre, one hard-edge darker teal depth band crossing horizontally behind the middle, and a third very faint sparse contour ring set whispered across the lower third behind the type area, lower edge calming to a subtle vertical deepening of the same teal, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, no texture gradients beyond printed lines, no objects
